title: Skydance plans a combined Paramount+ and HBO Max streamer for early 2027
dek: The company told shareholders the merged service would come at one price. It did not give the price.

body.p: Skydance said on Monday, November 9, 2026, that it plans to launch a combined Paramount+ and HBO Max streaming service as soon as early 2027, according to Variety, which reported the plan from a letter to shareholders.
No price has been announced. The company described the combined service as a single subscription at a better value than the two apps separately, but gave no number.
The report does not say how existing Paramount+ or HBO Max subscriptions will move to the new service. Until the company publishes those details, current plans and prices stay as they are.

body.h: What does it mean for your streaming budget?

body.p: Anyone paying for both services today is the most likely winner, since one bill could replace two. People who only want one of the two catalogs should watch whether the standalone apps stay available after the launch. That detail will decide whether this is a discount or a forced upgrade.

sources.label: Variety, Skydance plans launch of combined Paramount+, HBO Max streamer in early 2027 (Nov. 9, 2026)
